violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. -Observed open bags of food in freezer.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Observed dried food in microwave.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. -Observed bowl in hand sink.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. -Observed cardboard on floor under fryer. Cardboard is not a cleanable surface.
Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not maintained in good repair. -Observed cracked floor tiles in food prep area.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. - Reach in sliding door cooler at bar used to hold beverages and condiments has compressor drain issue/leak. Container used to collect water inside unit.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - General cleaning needed. Inside all coolers & freezers.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as needed. - General cleaning needed. Doors & side panels of all equipment.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as needed. - Hood/filters need cleaning.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - General cleaning needed.
